title: Energy Renewal Techniques
hook: Pushing through the 2pm slump usually just turns it into a 5pm crash.
statement: Use quick resets to restore your focus before you hit empty.
explainer: Focus can be restored, but only if the reset outpaces the fatigue. Catch it early and five minutes works. Wait until you crash and you're digging out of a hole.
sop: Learn 3 resets under 5 minutes: box breathing, a short walk, stretching.
Schedule short breaks before you feel drained.
Score your Fatigue from 1 to 10 and note your early warning signs.
Use a reset the moment you see a warning sign.
Track which Restoration works fastest and make it your go-to.
equation_example: Fatigue 7, Restoration 5. 5 - 7 = -2, still in the hole. Get Restoration to 8: 8 - 7 = 1, a small real gain. Higher means real focus is back. Below zero means you're running on empty no matter how hard you push.
question: Write down your fastest reset and the warning sign that tells you to use it.
closing_statement: A five-minute reset early beats an hour late.
caption:
Principle Nº 228: Energy Renewal Techniques

Pushing through the 2pm slump usually just turns it into a 5pm crash.

Use quick resets to restore your focus before you hit empty.

Your turn: Write down your fastest reset and the warning sign that tells you to use it.
